STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_00875_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_00875_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_00875(
    input iCLK,         
    input iRST_n,       
    input iIRDA,        
    output oDATA_READY,  
    output [31:0] oDATA         
);

parameter IDLE               = 2'b00;    
parameter GUIDANCE           = 2'b01;    
parameter DATAREAD           = 2'b10;    

parameter IDLE_HIGH_DUR      =  262143;  
parameter GUIDE_LOW_DUR      =  230000;  
parameter GUIDE_HIGH_DUR     =  210000;  
parameter DATA_HIGH_DUR      =  41500;	 
parameter BIT_AVAILABLE_DUR  =  20000;   

reg [31:0] oDATA;                 
reg [17:0] idle_count;            
reg idle_count_flag;       
reg [17:0] state_count;           
reg state_count_flag;     
reg [17:0] data_count;            
reg data_count_flag; 
reg [5:0] bitcount;  
reg [1:0] state;         
reg [31:0] data;   
reg [31:0] data_buf;   
reg data_ready; 

assign oDATA_READY = data_ready;

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        idle_count <= 0;
    else if (idle_count_flag)
        idle_count <= idle_count + 1'b1;
    else if (state != IDLE)
        idle_count <= 0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        idle_count_flag <= 1'b0;
    else if ((state == IDLE) && !iIRDA)
        idle_count_flag <= 1'b1;
    else 
        idle_count_flag <= 1'b0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        state_count <= 0;
    else if (state_count_flag)
        state_count <= state_count + 1'b1;
    else  
        state_count <= 0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        state_count_flag <= 1'b0;
    else if ((state == GUIDANCE) && iIRDA)
        state_count_flag <= 1'b1;
    else  
        state_count_flag <= 1'b0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        data_count <= 1'b0;
    else if(data_count_flag)
        data_count <= data_count + 1'b1;
    else 
        data_count <= 1'b0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        data_count_flag <= 0;
    else if ((state == DATAREAD) && iIRDA)
        data_count_flag <= 1'b1;
    else
        data_count_flag <= 1'b0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        bitcount <= 6'b0;
    else if (state == DATAREAD) begin
        if (data_count == 20000)
            bitcount <= bitcount + 1'b1; 
    end else
        bitcount <= 6'b0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        state <= IDLE;
    else
        case (state)
            IDLE: if (idle_count > GUIDE_LOW_DUR)
                state <= GUIDANCE;
            GUIDANCE: if (state_count > GUIDE_HIGH_DUR)
                state <= DATAREAD;
            DATAREAD: if ((data_count >= IDLE_HIGH_DUR) || (bitcount >= 33))
                state <= IDLE;
            default: state <= IDLE;
        endcase
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        data <= 0;
    else if (state == DATAREAD) begin
        if (data_count >= DATA_HIGH_DUR)
            data[bitcount-1'b1] <= 1'b1;  
    end else
        data <= 0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        data_ready <= 1'b0;
    else if (bitcount == 32) begin
        if (data[31:24] == ~data[23:16]) begin
            data_buf <= data;
            data_ready <= 1'b1;
        end else
            data_ready <= 1'b0;
    end else
        data_ready <= 1'b0;
end

always @(posedge iCLK or negedge iRST_n) begin
    if (!iRST_n)
        oDATA <= 32'b0000;
    else if (data_ready)
        oDATA <= data_buf;
end

endmodule
